intro.speaker: NARRATOR
intro.text: A breeze picks up. Tavri lifts her chin, ready to say something grand about it.

intro.speaker: TAVRI
intro.text: “The wind, like the ambitions of kings, is restless and—”

intro.speaker: NARRATOR
intro.text: She looks delighted with herself. Her tail is enjoying the wind enormously.

intro.speaker: TAVRI
intro.text: “The kings can get their own wind.”

options.labelText: “It *is* nice. Let’s stand in it for a bit.”

branch.speaker: NARRATOR
branch.text: You stand in it. It is, as reported, nice.

options.labelText: “No, finish it! ‘Restless and’ what? That was going somewhere.”

branch.speaker: NARRATOR
branch.text: She finishes the metaphor. It’s lovely. By then, the wind has moved on.
